adjudication.rationale: In lib/tasks/disqus.thor the PR removes the `--category/-c` Thor option (deleted `method_option :category`) and all logic that maps it to a category_id, so existing invocations using `-c/--category` will fail. It also replaces the PostCreator call that set `created_at: Date.parse(t[:created_at])` with `TopicEmbed.import_remote(user, t[:link], title: t[:title])`, and neither `import_remote` nor `TopicEmbed.import` pass a `created_at` option into `PostCreator`, so imported threads/posts will default to current timestamps instead of original Disqus dates.
